scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/public dist/build/components/ui dist/build/lib dist/build/pages && find . -name 'index.html' -path '*/client/*' -exec cp {} dist/public/index.html \; && find . -path '*/client/src/*' \( -name 'App.tsx' -o -name 'main.tsx' -o -name '*.css' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/ \; && find . -name 'queryClient.*' -not -name '*.d.ts' -exec cp {} dist/build/lib/ \; && find . -name 'Navigation.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/components/ \; && find . -name 'Footer.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/components/ \; && find . -name 'Home.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/pages/ \; && find . -name 'About.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/pages/ \; && find . -name 'toaster.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/components/ui/ \; && find . -name 'tooltip.*' \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cp {} dist/build/components/ui/ \; && find . -path '*/components/*' -name '*.tsx' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "dist/build/components/$(basename "$1")"' _ {} \; && find . -path '*/ui/*' \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "dist/build/components/ui/$(basename "$1")"' _ {} \; && find . -path '*/lib/*' \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -name '*.d.ts' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "dist/build/lib/$(basename "$1")"' _ {} \; && find . -path '*/pages/*' \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "dist/build/pages/$(basename "$1")"' _ {} \; && if [ -d shared ]; then cp -r shared dist/build/; fi && cd dist/build && esbuild main.tsx --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../public/main.js --platform=browser --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=text --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --alias:@=. && cd ../.. && sed -i 's|/src/main.tsx|./main.js|g' dist/public/index.html && rm -rf dist/build && esbuild server/index.ts --platform=node --packages=external --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js
